title: The element at index i
prompt: On a toy type of vector expressions (Vec(buf), Bcast(value), Add(a, b), Mul(a, b)), write at(e: VExp, i: str) -> SExp: the scalar expression for element i of e, built from Load(buf, idx), Const(value), SAdd and SMul. The printer show is given.
hints: Each class has one rule. What is the element at i of a broadcast scalar?
Bcast(c) is Const(c) at every index. Add(a, b) at i is SAdd(at(a, i), at(b, i)), and Mul is the same with SMul.
Add one case per class to the match, and pass the same index variable down to both children: elementwise means index i of the result only needs index i of the operands.
explain: Rangeify asks every value for its element at an index. An elementwise op at i needs only its operands at i, a buffer read becomes a scalar load at i, and a broadcast ignores the index. The result has no shapes left, so it can sit inside a for loop over i.
